info.title: AnhTester Book Management API
info.description: A comprehensive API for managing books, users, categories, promotions, and addresses, provided by [AnhTester](https://anhtester.com). The API is designed to be easy to use and supports a wide range of operations for book management, user management, category management, promotion management, and address management.             UI page to run this API: [book.anhtester.com](https://book.anhtester.com)

tags.name: Authentication Management
tags.description: Manage user authentication, including creation and refresh of JWT tokens.

tags.name: User Management
tags.description: Manage user accounts, including creating, updating, and deleting user information.

tags.name: Book Management
tags.description: Manage book information, including creating, updating, and retrieving book lists.

tags.name: Category Management
tags.description: Manage book categories, including creating and updating category lists.

tags.name: Address Management
tags.description: Manage address information in Vietnam, including creation, retrieval, and updates.

tags.name: Promotion Management
tags.description: Manage promotions, update information, and provide promotion details.

tags.name: Order Management
tags.description: Checkout: quote a list of books (no login), place an order, list / view / cancel your own orders. Prices are always computed by the server from the books' current selling price; shipping is free over 500,000 VND or when a book has a FREE_SHIPPING promotion in effect, otherwise 30,000 VND.

tags.name: Cart Management
tags.description: Server-side shopping cart of the signed-in user (one line per book, 1 – 99 copies, at most 50 books). Reading the cart always returns current prices and totals (same rules as POST /api/order/quote). Guests keep their cart in the browser and merge it with POST /api/cart/merge after signing in. Placing an order removes the ordered books from the cart.

get.description:
`GET /api/address`

Get all provincial-level divisions of Vietnam under the current 2-tier administrative system (effective 2025-07-01): 34 provinces / centrally-run cities, ordered by administrative code (Thành phố Hà Nội → Tỉnh Cà Mau). There is no district level any more.

get.summary: List wards / communes of a province
get.description:
`GET /api/address/{divname}`

Get all commune-level divisions (phường, xã, đặc khu) of the given province, ordered by administrative code. `divname` must be the full name returned by `GET /api/address`, e.g. `Thành phố Hồ Chí Minh` (URL-encoded). Unknown name returns `[]`.

`GET /api/book`

Query list of books (pagination, filtering, sorting). `picture` only lists files that exist. A plain-text `search` matches `name`, `description`, `slug`, `author`, `publisher` and `isbn`.

**Pricing rule.** `currentPrice` (selling price) is computed by the server and cannot be sent: `price` minus the discounts of the promotions attached to the book that are **in effect** (`isActive = true` and `startDate <= now <= endDate`). PERCENTAGE takes off `price * value / 100`, FIXED_AMOUNT takes off `value`, FREE_SHIPPING does not change the price; discounts of several promotions add up. The result is rounded to an integer and always stays within `[0, price]`. It is recalculated when the book (price, promotions) or any attached promotion changes, and when a promotion starts or ends.

currentPrice.description: Selling price after promotions in effect. Always between 0 and `price`.

hasPreview.description: `true` when the book has a sample chapter (`previewContent`). Read it from GET /book/{id}.

promotions.description: Active, not yet expired promotions (includes scheduled ones that have not started).

post.description:
`POST /api/book`

Create a new book. Returns **201**.

- `name` is trimmed and must not be blank; `slug` is normalized (`Đắc Nhân Tâm` → `dac-nhan-tam`) and must not end up empty.
- `price`: integer 0 – 1,000,000,000 (default 50,000).
- No `promotions` (or `[]`) → no promotion attached, `currentPrice = price`.
- `author`, `publisher`, `publishYear`, `pageCount`, `isbn`, `language`, `previewTitle`, `previewContent` are optional (see the schema for limits); `null` or a blank string clears them.

**Pricing rule.** `currentPrice` (selling price) is computed by the server and cannot be sent: `price` minus the discounts of the promotions attached to the book that are **in effect** (`isActive = true` and `startDate <= now <= endDate`). PERCENTAGE takes off `price * value / 100`, FIXED_AMOUNT takes off `value`, FREE_SHIPPING does not change the price; discounts of several promotions add up. The result is rounded to an integer and always stays within `[0, price]`. It is recalculated when the book (price, promotions) or any attached promotion changes, and when a promotion starts or ends.

name.description: Unique book name (trimmed, must not be blank).

slug.description: Optional. Normalized by the server (lowercase, `đ` → `d`, accents removed, non-alphanumerics dropped). Defaults to slugify(name). Must be unique.

pictures.description: Paths of images uploaded with POST /api/file into `/$book-image/` (e.g. `/$book-image/dac-nhan-tam/bia-truoc.jpg`). Any other path (outside `/$book-image/`, `..`, commas) → 422 `fields.pictures`.

categories.description: Category names. Names are trimmed. Unknown names are created automatically and must be non-blank, at most 24 characters and must not contain '/' (422 `fields.categories`). Existing categories are matched as stored.

price.description: Regular price in VND: integer, 0 – 1,000,000,000. Default 50,000.

promotions.description: Promotion ids. Every id must exist (404 otherwise).

author.description: Optional. Author name(s), at most 191 characters. `null` / `""` clears it.

publisher.description: Optional. Publisher, at most 191 characters. `null` / `""` clears it.

publishYear.description: Optional. Publication year: integer from 1000 to the current year (422 `fields.publishYear` if in the future). `null` clears it.

pageCount.description: Optional. Number of pages: integer 1 – 100,000. `null` clears it.

isbn.description: Optional. ISBN-10 or ISBN-13. Hyphens and spaces are removed, `x` is upper-cased; the result must be a valid ISBN-10 (9 digits + digit or `X`) or ISBN-13 (13 digits), check digit included (422 `fields.isbn`). Stored without hyphens. Not unique. `null` / `""` clears it.

language.description: Optional. Language of the book (e.g. `Tiếng Việt`, `English`), at most 50 characters. `null` / `""` clears it.

previewTitle.description: Optional. Title of the sample chapter ("read a sample"), at most 191 characters. `null` / `""` clears it.

previewContent.description: Optional. Sample chapter text, at most 20,000 characters. Plain text: paragraphs separated by a blank line, a line starting with `## ` is a subheading. `null` / `""` clears it.

`DELETE /api/book/{id}`

Delete a book. Its picture files in `/$book-image/` are deleted too (unless another book still uses the same file), and the book image folder is removed when it becomes empty.

patch.description:
`PATCH /api/book/{id}`

Partially update a book. **Fields not sent are kept unchanged** (no default values are applied).

- `categories` and `promotions`, when sent, **replace** the whole list (`promotions: []` removes all promotions).
- `pictures`, when sent, replaces all pictures.
- `slug`, when sent, is normalized; changing `name` alone does not change `slug`.
- `currentPrice` is recalculated after every update.
- `author`, `publisher`, `publishYear`, `pageCount`, `isbn`, `language`, `previewTitle`, `previewContent` are optional (see the schema for limits); `null` or a blank string clears them.

**Pricing rule.** `currentPrice` (selling price) is computed by the server and cannot be sent: `price` minus the discounts of the promotions attached to the book that are **in effect** (`isActive = true` and `startDate <= now <= endDate`). PERCENTAGE takes off `price * value / 100`, FIXED_AMOUNT takes off `value`, FREE_SHIPPING does not change the price; discounts of several promotions add up. The result is rounded to an integer and always stays within `[0, price]`. It is recalculated when the book (price, promotions) or any attached promotion changes, and when a promotion starts or ends.

delete.description:
`DELETE /api/cart`

Remove every book from the cart. Clearing an empty cart also returns 200.

bookId.description: The book's id (or the value sent, when the book was not found).

name.description: Empty string when the book was not found.

slug.description: Empty string when the book was not found.

picture.description: File path of the first existing picture (view it at `/view-file/<path>`).

price.description: Regular price. 0 when the book was not found.

unitPrice.description: Selling price (`currentPrice`). 0 when the book was not found.

available.description: `false` when the book was not found or is UNAVAILABLE. Such lines are excluded from totals.

error.description: `Book not found.` or `Book is unavailable.`; `null` when available.

addedAt.description: When the book was first added to the cart. Lines are sorted by it, oldest first.

totalQuantity.description: Number of copies in the cart (all lines, including unavailable ones).

canCheckout.description: `true` when the cart is not empty and every line is available.

get.description:
`GET /api/cart`

The current user's cart with up-to-date prices and totals. An empty cart returns `items: []` and zero totals.

One line per book, quantity 1 – 99, at most 50 different books. `bookId` (body or path) accepts a book **id or slug**; responses always use the book's id.

A book that became UNAVAILABLE stays in the cart with `available: false` and is excluded from the totals; `canCheckout` is then `false` until it is removed.

**Pricing rule (server-side, client prices are never trusted).** `price` = regular price, `unitPrice` = selling price = the book's `currentPrice` at order time (regular price minus promotions in effect). `lineTotal = unitPrice × quantity`; `subtotal = Σ lineTotal`; `discount = Σ (price − unitPrice) × quantity` (informational, already included in `unitPrice`). `shippingFee` = **0** when at least one book has a FREE_SHIPPING promotion in effect (`isActive` and `startDate <= now <= endDate`) or `subtotal >= 500,000` (FREE_SHIP_THRESHOLD), otherwise **30,000** (SHIPPING_FEE). `total = subtotal + shippingFee`. Amounts are integers in VND.

post.summary: Add a book to my cart
post.description:
`POST /api/cart/items`

Add `quantity` copies (default 1) of a book. A book already in the cart has its quantity **increased** (200); a new book creates a line (201). Returns the whole cart.

One line per book, quantity 1 – 99, at most 50 different books. `bookId` (body or path) accepts a book **id or slug**; responses always use the book's id.

- Book not found → **404** `Book not found.`
- Book UNAVAILABLE → **422** `fields.bookId`.
- Quantity in the cart would exceed 99 → **422** `fields.quantity` (nothing is changed).
- 50 different books already in the cart → **422** `fields.bookId`.

post.description:
`POST /api/order`

Place an order for the current user. `items` usually comes from the cart (GET /api/cart). Returns **201** with the order. Everything is created in one transaction.

`items`: 1 – 50 lines, `quantity` integer 1 – 99. `bookId` accepts a book **id or slug**. Lines pointing to the same book are merged (quantities added; the merged quantity must still be at most 99).

Validation → **422** `{ msg: "Invalid data.", fields }`:
- `recipientName`: trimmed, 1 – 191 characters.
- `phone`: spaces, dots and hyphens removed, must be a Vietnamese mobile number `^(0|\+84)(3|5|7|8|9)\d{8}$`; stored with a leading `0` (`+84912345678` → `0912345678`).
- `province` must exist in GET /api/address; `ward` must belong to that province (GET /api/address/{province}).
- `street`: trimmed, 1 – 255 characters. `note`: optional, at most 1,000 characters.
- `items`: any book that is not found or UNAVAILABLE → `fields.items` with one message per book. No order is created.
- `paymentMethod`: `COD` (default) or `BANK_TRANSFER`. New orders have status `PENDING`.

Books in the order are **removed from the user's server cart** (`/api/cart`) in the same transaction; other cart lines stay.

Each order line stores a snapshot (name, slug, first picture, prices) so the order stays readable after the book changes or is deleted (`bookId` becomes `null`).

**Pricing rule (server-side, client prices are never trusted).** `price` = regular price, `unitPrice` = selling price = the book's `currentPrice` at order time (regular price minus promotions in effect). `lineTotal = unitPrice × quantity`; `subtotal = Σ lineTotal`; `discount = Σ (price − unitPrice) × quantity` (informational, already included in `unitPrice`). `shippingFee` = **0** when at least one book has a FREE_SHIPPING promotion in effect (`isActive` and `startDate <= now <= endDate`) or `subtotal >= 500,000` (FREE_SHIP_THRESHOLD), otherwise **30,000** (SHIPPING_FEE). `total = subtotal + shippingFee`. Amounts are integers in VND.

post.description:
`POST /api/order/quote`

Price a list of books without placing an order (no login needed), e.g. a guest's browser cart. Signed-in users get their server cart already priced from GET /api/cart. Call this to show up-to-date prices, availability and totals.

`items`: 1 – 50 lines, `quantity` integer 1 – 99. `bookId` accepts a book **id or slug**. Lines pointing to the same book are merged (quantities added; the merged quantity must still be at most 99).

- A book that does not exist → line with `available: false`, `error: "Book not found."`, empty `name`/`slug`, prices 0.
- A book with status UNAVAILABLE → `available: false`, `error: "Book is unavailable."`.

- When no line is available, `shippingFee` is 0.
